methodology: Offline built mall. Explicit candidates position the player 40px outside each passage and keep enemies on long attack cooldowns. Keyboard walking/sprinting crosses the actual scene geometry ten round trips per mode; health/stamina are reset between sprint loops. This checks geometry/input and conservation, not combat, natural travel or human/reference-image recognition.
